claims.content: To process a Claim (Treatment Form) submitted by a VSP to the MSIU Field Office by validating the claim form manually and through the system and entering satisfactory claims into the system.

goal.raw_text: To process a Claim (Treatment Form) submitted by a VSP to the MSIU Field Office by validating the claim form manually and through the system and entering satisfactory claims into the system.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The VSP has submitted the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field Office in accordance with the payment terms (Bi-monthly / Monthly) mentioned in the VSP master.
The attending doctor has filled the claim form.
The patient has provided the voucher according to the visit type and patient type (client or partner), and the voucher is stuck to the claim form.
The thumb print has been placed on the claim form on completion of the service.
The MSIU Field Office User receives a Claim (Treatment Form) submitted by a VSP to the MSIU Field Office.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User receives a Claim (Treatment Form) submitted by a VSP to the MSIU Field Office.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User receives the collected Claim (Treatment Form) sent by the VSP to the MSIU Field Office.
The MSIU Field Office User validates the claim form manually and through the system.
The system interfaces with the bar-code reader to perform voucher number verifications and claim form entry.
The system interfaces with the thumb-print reader for verifying claims form used by the clients.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the information exactly into the system from the manual claim form.
The system accepts the claim only if the mandatory information is complete.
The claim is entered on to the system in the following month’s batch.
If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area.
The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month’s batch.

Exception path 1: If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area; the quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month’s batch. Exit: the claim is rejected/quarantined or entered on to the system in the following month’s batch after satisfactory resubmission.

Exception path 2: If the system is found more than two fraud entries during the claim process of particular VSP, then the system would automatically change the status of that particular VSP as In-activate; activation of that particular VSP is again purely based on MSIU Management decision. Exit: the VSP status is In-activate and activation is purely based on MSIU Management decision.
The claim form has been validated manually and through the system.
The claim has been entered on to the system in the following month's batch.
